kinds.d: Program for building and querying a database on one's own computer, with forms and reports or as a single file.
Program that shows a text terminal for a local shell, serial line or remote connection.
Program that connects to remote servers by SSH or transfers files by FTP or SFTP.
Program that captures and inspects network traffic.

notes: Restraint-only. Old 'Database software' renamed Desktop database software and cut 65->9 per brief: database servers and enterprise/cloud DBMSs dropped (Oracle, SQL Server, Db2, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SAP HANA, Teradata, CockroachDB etc.); Paradox, Visual FoxPro and Superbase kept as icons of the kind; Microsoft Office range dropped. Gap noticed: LibreOffice Base and SQLite GUI tools named in the brief are absent from the old data and were not added (needs web pass). Terminal emulator 65->20 leaders plus HyperTerminal as icon; SSH clients (PuTTY, SecureCRT, Xshell, Termius, Bitvise etc.) kept only under SSH and FTP client; mainframe and serial emulators (RUMBA, x3270, PComm), connection managers and minor tails dropped. SSH and FTP client 41->16 (dropped server/library components Dropbear and wolfSSH, mainframe TN3270 Plus, enterprise Tectia and WS_FTP, connection managers and minor tails). Network analyser 27->7: surveillance products (Carnivore, Clusterpoint), hardware appliances and enterprise suites (Allegro, Observer, Sniffer, SteelCentral, OmniPeek, Capsa), discontinued Microsoft tools and attack tools (Cain and Abel, dSniff, Ettercap) dropped. No new kinds.
